Eye-tracking while reading: agreement attraction

Source: R/data.R
agreement_attraction.Rd

Reading measures on the verb in sentences like The key to the cabinet(s) was/were rusty: grammaticality by number of the attractor noun. A plural attractor makes ungrammatical were easier to read. 40 participants read 32 items, each in one condition (four counterbalanced lists).

Usage

agreement_attraction

Format

A tibble with 1280 rows and 10 columns:

participant

Participant ID, P01 to P40.

list

Counterbalancing list, 1 to 4.

item

Item ID, i01 to i32.

grammaticality

"grammatical" or "ungrammatical".

attractor

Number of the attractor noun, "singular" or "plural".

skipped

1 if the verb was skipped in first-pass reading.

first_fixation

Duration of the first fixation on the verb in ms; NA if skipped.

gaze_duration

Sum of first-pass fixations in ms; NA if skipped.

regression

1 if the reader made a regression out of the verb in first pass; NA if skipped.

total_time

Sum of all fixations on the verb in ms; NA if never fixated.

Source

data-raw/agreement_attraction.R

Details

True model: log(gaze_duration) = 5.55 + 0.14 * ungrammatical - 0.09 * ungrammatical * plural, with by-participant (SD 0.15) and by-item (SD 0.08) intercepts and residual SD 0.3. First-pass regressions, in log-odds: -1.9 + 0.9 * ungrammatical - 0.5 * ungrammatical * plural, by-participant SD 0.5. Skipping rate about 14%, unrelated to condition.

References

Bock, K. & Miller, C. A. (1991). Broken agreement. Cognitive Psychology, 23(1), 45-93. doi:10.1016/0010-0285(91)90003-7

Examples

aggregate(gaze_duration ~ grammaticality + attractor, data = agreement_attraction,
          FUN = mean)
#>   grammaticality attractor gaze_duration
#> 1    grammatical  singular      271.5694
#> 2  ungrammatical  singular      306.6347
#> 3    grammatical    plural      276.6960
#> 4  ungrammatical    plural      286.7132
mean(agreement_attraction$skipped)
#> [1] 0.1429688
if (requireNamespace("lme4", quietly = TRUE)) {
  m <- lme4::lmer(log(gaze_duration) ~ grammaticality * attractor + (1 | participant) +
                    (1 | item), data = agreement_attraction)
  lme4::fixef(m)
}
#>                                 (Intercept) 
#>                                  5.55015633 
#>                 grammaticalityungrammatical 
#>                                  0.11821301 
#>                             attractorplural 
#>                                  0.01384567 
#> grammaticalityungrammatical:attractorplural 
#>                                 -0.08109389
